label: A necessary concrete source at w gives being in an accessible history
paraphrase: A stronger analyst interpretation of the necessary-concrete conclusion: in the selected world w there is one actual concrete individual c existing there and in every accessible world, and in some history v accessible from w the SAME c actually gives being, by the shared CausalityFrame.GivesAt primitive, to every contingent concrete member at each moment of its presence with at least one exercise. Necessary existence at w does not imply actual giving at w; nor does giving imply uniquely being God or the ultimate ground. Reuses the BEGINS_2 causal opportunity premises without replacing the weaker root node.
